basics.summary: Software engineer at Meta Platforms building scalable AI systems that connect machine learning research with production products.

work.company: Meta Platforms, Inc. — Menlo Park, CA
work.summary: Key contributor to Meta AI's flagship models: Muse Spark 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, and Muse Glimmer.
highlights: Lead the development of a Recursive Self-Improvement pipeline for LLM post-training synthetic data generation with an emphasis on improving Meta AI's long-horizon coding capabilities.
Develop RL data generation methodologies for training LLMs on AI for Science (AI4S) tasks, targeting natural science and engineering research capabilities.
Build robust evaluation frameworks for measuring LLM capabilities across various coding domains.
Design frameworks to systematically measure and evaluate LLM post-training data quality.

work.summary: Built lead-engagement infrastructure for Meta Business Suite; enabled real-time commerce for global SMBs.
highlights: Optimized analytics for enterprise-scale mobile systems.

work.summary: Integrated Llama 3 into Messenger at scale for US-led AI deployment.
highlights: Designed storage schemas with SQLite and used LangChain for model integration and tuning.
